what: Clicking a link to another page on the same site spreads an accent-color panel from the left (clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) → 0) over 1s cubic-bezier(1,0,.175,1) until it covers the screen, then navigates. On the new page the covering panel folds from its left edge to the right (0 → inset(0 0 0 100%)) over the same 1s and clears — the curve sits almost still and then snaps shut at the end, giving the feel of a door slamming shut and swinging open.

options.wait: Extra wait (sec) before advancing once fully covered, default 0
options.ease: Curve with four numbers (「1,0,.175,1」), default original curve
options.fx:done: Event the element fires once the panels have fully cleared on the incoming page
options.go: At what fraction of the cover duration to hand over (0–1), default 1 — the original uses .73 (when the door is 94% closed, motion-probe reads 733ms)

note: The arrived flag is kept in sessionStorage — pages opened fresh or typed directly in the address bar are not covered (the original also has no door on first entry)

from.where: /  shared.js body — original default layout .door (Nuxt page transition) · phone menu #GlobalMenu also uses the same clip 1s
